sharedCandidateRules:
Register at most one magical candidate per physical family before commitment. The actual lead must directly operate it for at least one active minute in genuinely necessary compatible work, or throughout a genuinely shorter separately authorized task. Setup alone, token contact, an assistant's use and unused carried gear do not qualify. At qualifying work and the single resolution checkpoint, the complete item must be positive-HP, accessible, unsuppressed, unmelded and participating. Use current views for every registered candidate and the same physical histories for task admission and effects. Ordinary indispensable tools remain required even when unenchanted. Later suppression, repair or a new owner cannot rewrite a resolved claim. Pauses preserve the same unresolved claim; replacement leads require an accepted record and a genuinely feasible full lead workflow without reversing completed work. No late enchanted candidate or borrowed work interval.

These are durable magical nonartifact tools without attunement, charges, RP, concentration or a separate magic activation. Ordinary structural AC protects the object, not its bearer. Names, tags, donors, rarity, price and legacy effects grant no unprinted power, proficiency, formula, ingredient stock or acquisition permission. No Forge Dwarf artisan time/quality benefit applies. No tool imprint improves its creation, research, copying, identification, appraisal, repair or combat unless a separate exact rule expressly authorizes that task. Other actual class/spell/equipment effects retain their own predicates and stacking; these comparison families are not universal stacking rules.
